info.title: HyperZone proposed realtime supplier extensions
info.description: Local receiving implementation only. All endpoint names, configuration keys, source permission proof fields and publication details in this file are proposed-awaiting-fop. They are not deployed APIs or evidence of live integration.

x-remaining-dependencies.supplier: FOP confirms C09 authoritative account source; implements and publishes both dedicated APIs, contacts capability and source/ownership checks. Provide endpoint URLs, formal source relationships and real test examples. FOP access remains paused until separately authorized.
x-remaining-dependencies.physicalReturn: FOP must confirm formal entity and independent source read/relationship semantics; FOP_KINGDEE_PHYSICAL_RETURN_ENTITY stays empty until then. Refund application cannot substitute. Contact-only adapter returns no invented return quantity.
x-remaining-dependencies.reservedCustomerCandidates: Existing projection=customers/search contract is used. Local parser requires complete=true AND total=items.length<=100. Truncation raises fop_reserved_customers_search_required and tells the caller to narrow the customer name/code. No pagination fields invented; current inventory UI already searches customer text and paginates inventory directly. FOP must confirm exhaustive search behavior or publish a versioned candidate pagination contract.
x-remaining-dependencies.approvalResultLookup: A04 final endpoint/request/result contract and durable FOP idempotency records remain pending. No successful lookup API, not_found retry rule or irreversible local result ledger is introduced. Unknown operations remain unknown with no automatic write retry.
x-remaining-dependencies.approvalReadback: A05 committed sourceVersion/transaction event locator or barrier remains pending. Existing manual Sync data can capture a new barrier, but local refresh alone cannot confirm operation-specific propagation. UI explicitly states source approval and local-awaiting-sync; it does not claim readback confirmation.

x-configuration.FOP_KINGDEE_SUPPLIER_CONTACTS_URL: Blank until dedicated contact endpoint is published. Missing -> fop_supplier_contacts_not_configured, no legacy fallback.
x-configuration.FOP_KINGDEE_SUPPLIER_CHAT_URL: Blank until dedicated launch endpoint is published. Missing -> fop_supplier_contacts_not_configured.
x-configuration.FOP_KINGDEE_PHYSICAL_RETURN_ENTITY: Blank until formal FOP physical-return entity is confirmed; hzkj_purrefundapplybill prohibited.
x-configuration.FOP_QUERIES_PAUSED: Existing pause guard blocks both APIs before network access.

SupplierContact.description: For every non-return context require paid=true, cancelled=false and pending/partial shipmentStatus. Fulfillment/stock lines must be nonempty, unique by source line + purchase line, and carry the matching source line ID. For purchase_group and purchase_return lines must be empty: this extension does not define or invent whole-purchase or physical-return quantities. missing_account iff account is null; ready/chat_unavailable require a nonempty account. Account rejects controls. contactVersion is an opaque FOP-generated lowercase SHA-256 token accepted by the existing launch DTO, and must change with contact/source relationship changes.

checkedAt.description: No older than 60 seconds; future skew at most 5 seconds.

RealtimeEnvelope.description: Inside Kingdee {status:true,errorCode:"0",data:<this envelope>}. Exact subject/currentScope/resource, resource grant and configured organization checks remain mandatory. Each resource also requires the independent contacts capability; it cannot be inferred from order permission. Denials fail closed. No caller-supplied account, subject or currentScope is accepted by browser routes.

SupplierContactsResult.description: Fresh refreshedAt at most 60 seconds; duplicates rejected. At most one item for group/return. orderId equals groupId for groups, otherwise original orderId. An empty list is allowed only with successful source/contacts/relationship proof. For purchase_return require sourceEntity exactly FOP_KINGDEE_PHYSICAL_RETURN_ENTITY; formal entity and semantics are still awaiting FOP. Reject hzkj_purrefundapplybill. No registered source/entity is invented by this file.

SupplierLaunchResult.description: Echo exact purchaseOrderId and contactVersion; context excludes these two launch fields. BFF first obtains fresh contacts and compares the supplied version/account, then calls this endpoint and rechecks local account/scope. Only aliim:sendmsg?touid=cnalichn<account> (optional siteid=cnalichn) accepted; no host, fragment, duplicate parameters or additional parameters. Null URL means unavailable; never construct an alternative URL.
